title: Keep the host when he carries the story
text: Keep the host when he carries the story: the chapter question, the challenge the viewer wants asked, the clearest summary, the verdict, legal cover. Cut his warm-up, clarifying questions, name checks, filler, most jokes and his on-air intro and recap (HKS-C4, C7, 2026-11-24). Keep a host connector to bridge pieces that don't join. Host reactions may be added for drama.

source.heading: Cut rules for the long form (step 3)

confirm: For each kept host line, which role does it play (chapter question, challenge, summary, verdict, legal cover, connector)?
